text: {who}: "{owner} at {address} has been a thorn for months. Fine them on the next thing you find. Anything."

choices.label: Agree to look closely
choices.result: Walt is pleased. {owner} will notice the extra attention.

text: {who}: "{owner} at {address} is a good neighbor. If a notice crosses your desk, let it slide. Quietly."

choices.label: Quietly agree
choices.result: Easy now. Someone is keeping a list of favors, and it isn't Ben.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.result: Ben says he understands. His tone says otherwise.

text: {who}: "The reserve fund is thin. Skip the landscaper's invoice this month and call it a 'review'."

choices.label: Delay the payment
choices.result: The treasury looks better. The lawn crew looks angrier.

choices.label: Pay on time
choices.result: Pat writes the amount down twice.

text: {who}: "Disclaimer, disclaimer. The file on {address} has gaps. Please re-document before anyone says 'lawyer'."

choices.label: Brush it off
choices.result: Dana adds a footnote to your file.

text: {who}: "Let's skip the next fine and hold a neighborhood potluck at {address}. Everyone's invited!"

choices.label: Host the potluck
choices.result: Seven casseroles. One argument about the casseroles.

text: {who}: "I'm thinking about running for president next year. Unless you'd like to... reconsider your approach to {address}."

choices.label: Hold my ground
choices.result: Ben starts attending meetings with a clipboard of his own.

choices.label: Offer him a committee
choices.result: A subcommittee is born. It meets monthly. Nobody knows why.

text: {who}: "The notice for {address} skipped a required step. I'm not saying it's a problem. I'm saying I'm writing it down."

choices.label: Fix the process
choices.result: Dana crosses something out, looks almost relieved.

choices.label: Defend the notice
choices.result: The footnote grows a second footnote.

text: {who}: "Someone leaked the file on {address} to the neighborhood group. It wasn't me. I only know because I read it."

choices.label: Investigate the leak
choices.result: Everyone is a suspect. The potluck is awkward.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.result: The file gets a dozen thumbs-up emojis.

text: {who}: "The landscaper is overpriced. I found a cousin's company. It's cheaper. It also doesn't have a truck."

choices.label: Switch vendors
choices.result: The new crew arrives by bicycle. It's a start.
